lines.text: Figma runs tens of thousands of sealed boxes so AI-written code can run safely.
A sandbox is a sealed space for untrusted code. Figma's platform for them is called Nimbus.
lines.title: Key ideas

lines.text: A team writes a short settings file. Nimbus picks a cloud provider and hands back a ready sandbox.
lines.title: Getting a sandbox

lines.text: Keeping sandboxes warm and waiting cut start-up time by 90 percent. Availability rose from 99 to 99.95 percent.
lines.title: Warm pool results

lines.text: Code in a sandbox may read from any site, but can only send data to hosts on an approved list.
lines.title: Network rules

lines.text: Secrets are scrambled inside the box. The real value is swapped in only when going to the right place.
lines.title: Protecting secrets

lines.text: Running AI code safely needs strict boxes that start fast and survive provider outages.
lines.title: Takeaways
